data.body: AC evidence (Gerrit 1899 PS2, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1; 29 tests in state/test_rich_reemit_state.py plus 3310 reconciler/interfaces tests green; lint 0, typecheck 566, comment-hygiene 0, config-ownership 0). AC1 changed wire produces the same hash/counter and the same persisted bytes as the legacy sequence -> test_narrow_operation_matches_the_legacy_counter_progression (0,1,2 and reaching RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT at the same emit) and test_narrow_operation_persists_the_same_bytes_as_the_legacy_sequence, a DIFFERENTIAL oracle driving both paths over identical stores and comparing bytes after one save; plus test_a_changed_wire_resets_the_counter_and_rewrites_the_digest. AC2 (as corrected) the operation performs NO save of its own on any path -> test_the_operation_performs_no_save_at_either_layer, which counts saves at BOTH the facade and the repository. AC3 missing bindings remain nonfatal with the current result -> test_a_missing_binding_is_nonfatal_and_distinguishable (returns None, asserts None != 0, and confirms the legacy sequence returns None too). AC4 all_bindings stays shallow and facade signatures unchanged -> test_all_bindings_copy_depth_is_unchanged_by_the_new_seam (outer mapping fresh per call, inner entries shared). AC5 no production adapter receives direct repository or lifecycle mutation access -> test_the_narrow_operation_does_not_expose_the_owners scans every public member. Also test_a_converging_body_never_stores_the_counter pins the 0303 churn discipline (absent means zero). PLAN CORRECTION: the ticket originally credited this operation with save and dirty-gating behavior; neither exists - _observe_rich_reemit never saves per emit and BindingStore.save is unconditional - so the AC was corrected to no-save-on-any-path and byte parity is asserted after one save. MUTATION FOUND AN ORACLE GAP: the no-save test first watched only BindingStore.save, but the lifecycle owner holds the repository directly, so a self._repo.save() was invisible; it now counts both layers and goes RED under exactly that mutation. apply_handlers.py deliberately untouched - the caller cutover is S3 T3.
